expectations.buyer: Pharmacy software vendors, wholesalers, PSAOs, dispensers, and DSCSA compliance teams
expectations.pain: Physical packages, identifiers, and EPCIS transaction data can diverge, creating quarantine and exception-handling failures
expectations.strongestIncumbent: FDA guidance and stabilization periods, GS1 standards and test tools, wholesaler/vendor sandboxes, EPCIS solution providers, and industry interoperability programs
expectations.biggestRisk: The stated November 2026 small-dispenser deadline may be outdated or oversimplified, incumbents may already test the flows, and synthetic drills may not predict production partner exceptions
